title: Do Thermal Blackout Curtains Keep a Room Warm in Winter? (India Guide)
excerpt: Thermal and blackout curtains slow the heat a room loses through cold glass at night, but only when hung wide, long and closed before sunset. What they do, where they help in India, and how to fit them.
seoTitle: Do Thermal Curtains Keep a Room Warm in Winter? India Guide
